comments.author: Blazkowicz
comments.body: You add this sail to any heavy ship. You add it through the special shipbuilding option at the shipyard master. However you'll need Special Shipbuilding Improvement Permits to do this. You have to buy those from the NC shop.

comments.author: Nicola
comments.body:
Would it replace my studding sails?

For example trading sambuk has 3 studding sails. If I add this are there only 2 studding sail slots left?

If so does it degrade over time or is it a permanent part of the ship?

comments.author: Blazkowicz
comments.body: These sails are added through special shipbuilding to your ship. They improve the sail stats of the ship. They cannon be put into your three sail slots in your sambuk.

comments.author: Holfina
comments.body:

Does the 40 to 50 depend on the shipbuilders skill, is it random or based somehow on ship stats?

comments.body: Oh, and another question, how many times can this be used per ship? Just once? Does it take up any slot or anything once used? Like if I use a large latin sail I can't make any more improvements?

comments.body: Once per Improvement. if your ship is 0/5 you can use this 5 times.. etc

comments.author: Nicola
comments.body: You can add one "sail" part, one "gunport" part and two "body" parts to a ship. This obviously is a sail part so you can use only one of these per improvement.
